create.bulkPlaceholder:
Paste API keys here, separated by commas, spaces, new lines, semicolons, or pipes.

Examples:
AIzaXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX1, AIzaXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX2, AIzaXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX3

Or:
AIzaXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX1
AIzaXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX2
AIzaXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX3

Each key should be at least 10 characters long.
create.jsonPlaceholder:
Paste a JSON array of API keys.

Examples:

Simple array:
["AIzaXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX1", "AIzaXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX2"]

Object array:
[
  {"name": "Gproxy key 1", "key": "AIzaXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX1"},
  {"name": "Gproxy key 2", "key": "AIzaXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX2"}
]

Supported fields: name/title/label, api_key_value/apiKey/key/value

Streaming responses are included when the proxy buffers the full upstream body for token parsing. Bodies may contain prompts or completions — enable only if you accept the storage and privacy trade-off.

meta.title: Gemini Proxy - API Key Management
meta.description: Production-ready admin for managing provider API keys, proxy keys, and request logs built with Ant Design and Supabase

hero.tagline: Production-Ready API Proxy for Google Gemini
hero.body: Secure key management, intelligent load balancing, comprehensive monitoring, and seamless streaming. Deploy anywhere with our multi-platform support.

features.heading: Core Features
features.subheading: Everything you need to manage, monitor, and scale your Gemini API usage

apiKeys.title: API Key Management
apiKeys.body: Secure storage and intelligent rotation of multiple Google Gemini API keys with real-time usage tracking.

loadBalancing.title: Load Balancing
loadBalancing.body: Intelligent request distribution across multiple API keys with automatic failover and retry mechanisms.

monitoring.title: Monitoring & Analytics
monitoring.body: Real-time request logging, performance metrics, cost tracking, and comprehensive dashboards.

security.title: Security & Access Control
security.body: Proxy API key management, request authentication, rate limiting, and secure environment handling.

logging.title: Comprehensive Logging
logging.body: Detailed request/response logs with performance metrics, retry attempts, and export capabilities.

platforms.title: Multi-Platform Support
platforms.body: Deploy anywhere with support for Next.js, Vercel, Cloudflare, Appwrite, and standalone servers.

footer.blurb: Production-ready proxy for Google Gemini with secure key management, intelligent load balancing, and comprehensive monitoring.

architecture.heading: Architecture
architecture.subheading: Simple, secure, and scalable architecture for production use
architecture.yourAppBody: Makes API requests using your preferred SDK
architecture.proxyBody: Intelligently routes requests to healthy API keys, logs request/response data, and manages load balancing
architecture.dataStorageBody: All data is securely stored in Supabase PostgreSQL with Row Level Security (RLS) enabled for maximum protection. API keys, request logs, and analytics are stored with proper access controls and are accessible only to authorized users.
architecture.securityBody: Built with enterprise-grade security including RLS policies, typed RPCs, secure environment handling, and comprehensive audit logging for compliance.

deployment.heading: Deployment Options
deployment.subheading: Choose the deployment option that best fits your needs

web.title: Next.js Web App
web.body: Complete solution with web interface + API proxy in one deployment. Built-in dashboard for managing API keys and monitoring.

api.title: Standalone API
api.body: Lightweight Node.js API server with minimal resource usage. Perfect for custom deployments and microservices.

edge.title: Edge Functions
edge.body: Deploy to Vercel, Cloudflare, or Appwrite for global CDN distribution and automatic scaling.
